nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.text: Red Hood! It's me again. The forest is getting darker — have you reached your grandmother yet?

nodes.speaker: redHood
nodes.text: Not yet... I stopped to pick more flowers. She loves them so much.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.text: I heard something moving in the bushes earlier. You shouldn't stay here alone.

choices.text: Let me walk you to her cottage.
Just tell me where she lives. I'll go ahead.

nodes.speaker: redHood
nodes.text: You'd do that? Her cottage is just beyond this grove, behind the third tree with red leaves. But let me gather these flowers first — it'll only be a moment.

nodes.speaker: redHood
nodes.text: Past the red-leafed trees, you'll see a small cottage. Please knock three times — she's hard of hearing. I'll catch up after I finish here.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.text: Something feels wrong about this forest. Be careful, Red Hood.

nodes.speaker: redHood
nodes.text: I will! Just a few more flowers and I'll be on my way. Thank you for worrying about me.
